_comment: DP2 FIX WAVE, non-canonical verification script (NOT registered in qa/manifest.json/CLAUDE.md's seed table -- does not count toward the 53 canonicals, ci_sweep.sh will never run it). Purpose: windowed-screenshot proof of the HIGH finding's FIRST half (condition_mode: absolute for the three one-shot-keyed bounties). Fixture dp2_fixwave_absolute_start already holds bounty_silk_line accepted with an EMPTY baseline and found_spider_silk already banked BEFORE acceptance (the exact soft-lock scenario) -- this script just walks to Selys and turns it in, proving the absolute-mode condition resolves MET immediately (no delta math, no re-doing the one-shot thing). Seed 9 for convention; fixture rng_state governs (no combat in this script).
